archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon accents)

background.description: Deep void black for the main background.

foreground.description: Off-white text for high contrast without harshness.

primary_neon.description: Electric purple used strictly for highlights, CTAs, and hover states.

secondary_deep.description: Deep indigo/purple for subtle gradients, active states, or card backgrounds.

surface.description: Slightly elevated black for cards and inputs.

border.description: Subtle border color to separate elements without clutter.

headings.description: Distinctive, geometric, wide display font for a strong 'producer' identity.

body_and_ui.description: Technical monospace font for labels, stats, BPM, and descriptions. Contrasts beautifully with Syne.

logo_fallback.description: Fallback graffiti/grunge font for 'TH' logo if image is unavailable.

global_styles.noise_texture: A fixed overlay with `pointer-events: none`, `mix-blend-mode: overlay`, and `opacity: 0.03` to add a subtle analog/grunge feel to the whole site.
global_styles.layout: Asymmetrical where possible, left-aligned typography, generous padding (`py-24` or `py-32` for sections).
global_styles.corners: Sharp or slightly rounded (`rounded-sm` to `rounded-md`, max 4px-8px) to maintain an edgy look.
global_styles.borders: 1px solid borders (`border-white/10`) extensively used to define cards without needing heavy backgrounds.

micro_animations.hover_lift: CSS transform: `translateY(-4px)` with a smooth `ease-out` transition (duration 300ms) and subtle box-shadow glow.
micro_animations.magnetic_feel: Slight scale up `scale(1.02)` on interactive cards.
micro_animations.staggered_reveals: Framer Motion `whileInView` with `opacity: 0`, `y: 20`, staggering children by 0.1s.
micro_animations.animated_waveform: CSS keyframes for beat cards on hover: multiple vertical bars spanning heights from 20% to 100% using `animation: pulse 0.8s infinite alternate`.
micro_animations.neon_glow: CTAs and active elements receive `box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(157, 76, 221, 0.4)` on hover.

navbar.layout: Fixed/Sticky top, `backdrop-blur-md` and `bg-black/70` after scroll. Generous side padding.
navbar.elements: Logo 'TH' on the left, Links (Home, Beats, Contact me) centered or right-aligned.
navbar.behavior: Smooth scroll to sections using standard anchor links or Framer Motion scroll.

hero.typography: H1: 'Welcome to the TebaHouse' (uppercase, extremely tight tracking, `text-5xl` to `text-7xl`). Tagline: 'More than just sound' (Monospace, purple accent).
hero.visuals: Dark moody studio image taking up significant space but fading into the background using a CSS gradient mask.
hero.effects: Subtle radial purple gradient glow behind the text (`bg-purple-900/20 blur-[100px]`).

about.layout: Bento-style or standard CSS Grid (2 columns on desktop).
about.left_column: Vertical studio image inside a sharp container.
about.right_column: Heading 'I'll turn your ideas into breathtaking tracks.', description text, and 2 animated stats counters.
about.stats: 9 Years of Experience, 50+ Positive Reviews (use Framer Motion for counting up).

services.styling: Dark surface (`bg-[#121214]`), `border border-white/5`. On hover: `border-[#9D4CDD]/50` and slight lift. Include `lucide-react` icons.

brands_marquee.layout: Full width, zero side padding, infinite scroll using Framer Motion or `react-fast-marquee`.
brands_marquee.content: Text logos or simple SVGs of FabFilter, IK Multimedia, Solid State Logic, Antares, Waves, Native Instruments.

beats_shop.layout: Responsive grid for covers (`grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5`).
beats_shop.cards: 1:1 square aspect ratio. Dark placeholder or abstract cover image.
beats_shop.hover_state: Overlay darkens, animated CSS waveform appears in the center.
beats_shop.interaction: Clicking a card opens an inline player module directly below the active row (or absolute overlay).
beats_shop.inline_player: Displays: Title, custom progress bar (animated line/ring), Time, BPM, Genre, Price. CTA: 'Contattami per acquistare'.

contact.layout: Centered or split layout with contact info on the left, form on the right.
contact.form_elements: Name, Email, Message inputs. Raw/minimalist styling: bottom borders only (`border-b border-white/20`), no full backgrounds for inputs. Floating labels if possible, or bold mono labels.
contact.submit_button: Magnetic hover effect, solid neon purple background or black with glowing neon border.

footer.content: Verona/Pescantina 37026, +39 375 526 4359, 7tebahouse@gmail.com. Social links (YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn). Legal links. 'TebaHouse © 2026'.
footer.typography: Small, muted, monospace for most info. Large logo text 'TH' in background or one corner.

images.description: Horizontal recording studio with neon lights. Best for hero section.
Vertical, moody studio shot. Perfect for the About section bento box.
Abstract DJ console glowing lights. Use as a default cover for beats in the shop.
Abstract audio interface sound waves. Alternate beat cover.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE INTER OR ROBOTO. Strictly use 'Syne' for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for body/UI text.
Do not use generic flat gradients. Use pure CSS background: #0a0a0b with subtle radial glows for depth.
Ensure the beat player uses pure CSS/Framer Motion for the waveform and progress ring, avoiding heavy external 3D/audio libraries unless essential.
Form submission must be wired to use the Resend SDK or a simulated mock API if keys are missing.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements as specified in the sections.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrappers for the main layout to preserve the gritty, custom aesthetic. Use raw divs with Tailwind.
Keep the aesthetic heavily inspired by underground producer portfolios: sharp, dark, heavily asymmetric, and extremely intentional with the use of the purple neon accent.
